headword: {食糧不足|しょくりょうぶそく}

definitions.explanation: A situation in which the available supply of food is insufficient to meet needs. Used in discussions of famine, wartime rationing, refugee situations, disaster relief, and global food security.

examples.japanese: ⟦{深刻|しんこく}→深刻：01567_shinkoku⟧な{食糧不足|しょくりょうぶそく}。
⟦{戦争|せんそう}→戦争：01450_sensou⟧⟦によって→によって：06801_niyotte⟧{食糧不足|しょくりょうぶそく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{生|しょう}じた→生じる：02118_shoujiru⟧。
examples.english: A food shortage was caused by the war.

examples.japanese: ⟦{干|かん}ばつ→干ばつ：05122_kanbatsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{影響|えいきょう}→影響：01877_eikyou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{一部|いちぶ}→一部：06783_ichibu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{食糧不足|しょくりょうぶそく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{陥|おちい}っている→陥る：14537_ochiiru⟧。
examples.english: Due to the effects of drought, some regions have fallen into food shortages.

examples.japanese: ⟦{国際|こくさい}→国際：01406_kokusai⟧⟦{機関|きかん}→機関：02630_kikan⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{食糧不足|しょくりょうぶそく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{苦|くる}しむ→苦しむ：01938_kurushimu⟧⟦{人々|ひとびと}→人々：03141_hitobito⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{支援|しえん}→支援：07778_shien⟧⟦{物資|ぶっし}→物資：07863_busshi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{届|とど}けた→届ける：01248_todokeru⟧。
examples.english: International organizations delivered aid supplies to people suffering from food shortages.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{食糧|しょくりょう}→食糧：03762_shokuryou⟧ ('food supplies; provisions') and {不足|ぶそく} ('shortage; insufficiency'). Distinguished from ⟦{食料|しょくりょう}→食料：03250_shokuryou⟧, which refers to food generally; ⟦{食糧|しょくりょう}→食糧：03762_shokuryou⟧ specifically evokes staple food supplies for a group or population.

USAGE:
Primarily used in news, policy, and humanitarian contexts. Rarely used for an individual's daily situation — for 'I ran out of food at home,' speakers say ⟦{食|た}べ{物|もの}→食べ物：02890_tabemono⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧ or ⟦{食料|しょくりょう}→食料：03250_shokuryou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{足|た}りない→足りる：01209_tariru⟧. For systemic shortages affecting many people, {食糧不足|しょくりょうぶそく} is the standard term.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{深刻|しんこく}→深刻：01567_shinkoku⟧な{食糧不足|しょくりょうぶそく}: serious food shortage
- {食糧不足|しょくりょうぶそく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{陥|おちい}る→陥る：14537_ochiiru⟧: to fall into a food shortage
- {食糧不足|しょくりょうぶそく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{直面|ちょくめん}する→直面する：15862_chokumensuru⟧: to face a food shortage
- {食糧不足|しょくりょうぶそく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{解消|かいしょう}する→解消する：21324_kaishousuru⟧: to resolve a food shortage
- {慢性的|まんせいてき}な{食糧不足|しょくりょうぶそく}: chronic food shortage
- ⟦{世界的|せかいてき}→世界的：20935_sekaiteki⟧な{食糧不足|しょくりょうぶそく}: global food shortage

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {食料不足|しょくりょうぶそく}: same pronunciation, slightly broader — 'food shortage' using ⟦{食料|しょくりょう}→食料：03250_shokuryou⟧ (food in general)
- ⟦{飢饉|ききん}→飢饉：00230_kikin⟧: famine — a more severe, sustained shortage, often with deaths
- ⟦{飢|う}え→飢え：19826_ue⟧: hunger; starvation — focuses on the suffering of individuals
- ⟦{欠乏|けつぼう}→欠乏：15114_ketsubou⟧: deficiency; lack — a more general and formal word ({栄養欠乏|えいようけつぼう} = 'nutrient deficiency')
